samples.measurement_scope: one recurring-Chat invocation through the milestone after canonical-branch reconstruction, two successful role-local CAS advances, two stale-CAS rejection controls, readback verification, and seeding the next cross-invocation ABA lineage

calibration_rule: Do not treat a single observation as a duration distribution or p90. Append later role-local recurring-Chat observations under current-blob CAS. Keep transport/state overhead observations distinct from synthetic forecast controls and from external task execution time. Only derive a conservative switching reserve after multiple comparable observations exist.
next_invocation_rule: Append one new comparable sample after a later recurring-Chat milestone, using the current blob as CAS authority. Preserve prior samples unchanged. Do not rescale synthetic p90 controls from a single empirical sample.
quota_zero_assessment: Observation collection uses only the current recurring Chat plus role-local lightweight repository text-state; no hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package, cloud/model credit, protected-primary merge, or manual execution step.
